failedAttemptAnalysis.initialAndEvalOptionAttempt: The synthetic wrapper used node -e. Node 24 run() adds unknown process.execArgv even when options.execArgv is empty. The child reevaluated the wrapper and reported zero test methods and zero observation frames. Both failed attempts remain recorded.
failedAttemptAnalysis.correction: Invoke the owned synthetic wrapper file, matching the production component CLI. The real Node test child then delivered START, three original records including cleanup, END and the expected assertion failure. No production helper change was made for this fixture defect.
